communication_law: Issue comments are durable coordination context, not automatically canonical architecture; canonical state must point to the durable source that governs the claim.
handoff_rule: A good update lets another Naya know what changed, what was proven, what was not proven and what to do next — without replaying the conversation.
purpose: The issues doctrine of the activation kit: the issue relay cycle, issue quality fields, the communication law, and the agent handoff rule.
title: OPERATIONS / ISSUES
